investigationSubject: Classification Reconciliation for Foundation Courses ELH-01 through ELH-11

reconciliationAnalysis.historicalContext: The 11 foundational courses were authored during initial platform seeding (Batch 1 and Batch 2). While they established basic functional assessments that passed early unit tests, they preceded the rigorous enterprise instructional quality standard introduced in Sprints 15.2.10C through 15.2.10K.

rootCausesForLegacyClassification.evidence: In the baseline audit, 100% of questions across ELH-01..11 had correctOption set to 0 (Index A). This predictable pattern compromises assessment integrity.
rootCausesForLegacyClassification.remediationStandard: Strictly enforce balanced [2, 2, 2, 2] answer key distribution per course (or [2, 3, 3, 2] for 10-question sets).

rootCausesForLegacyClassification.evidence: Questions were predominantly abstract definitions (e.g., 'What is the definition of operational sustainability?') rather than workplace decision dilemmas facing frontline employees.
rootCausesForLegacyClassification.remediationStandard: Elevate scenario orientation to >= 50% (achieved 100%) and Bloom's Application/Analysis depth to >= 60% (achieved 100%).

rootCausesForLegacyClassification.evidence: Option-level feedback in earlier batches was either missing, identical for multiple options, or lacking educational explanations of why distractors were flawed.
rootCausesForLegacyClassification.remediationStandard: Provide complete 4-element optionFeedback arrays with distinct, educational explanations for every single option.

rootCausesForLegacyClassification.evidence: The automated inventory generation scripts from Sprint 15.2.10B through 15.2.10K explicitly tracked remediated cohorts (15.2.10B through 15.2.10K), intentionally leaving ELH-01..11 as LEGACY_ACCEPTED until their comprehensive remediation in the final Sprint 15.2.10L.
rootCausesForLegacyClassification.remediationStandard: Systematically remediate all 11 courses to ELEVIO permanent enterprise standards in Group L1 of Sprint 15.2.10L, transitioning them to ENTERPRISE_READY.

conclusion: The LEGACY_ACCEPTED classification was accurate and necessary. Sprint 15.2.10L Group L1 fully resolves all instructional defects while preserving plain-language accessibility and Mauritian workplace context.
